4.1.draft: Post-hoc (E41-class) 2x2 tile-size x overlap grid, proposer stage only, consensus-only aggregation, 10 passes per cell, one configuration throughout (detect_brief-text, gemini-3-flash-preview, MINIMAL, T=0.7; 30,130 calls, $18.53 billed). Scored on the four-way tile-union intersection carried on the era-2-487 grid (487 carrier tiles, 20 m buffer), with the preregistered 20 m within-pass deduplication applied to every pass so denser tilings are not penalised for cross-tile duplicates. Best cell per configuration at K=10: 512 px / 12.5 % F1 0.6845 [0.6336,0.7313] MCC 0.5431; 512 px / 50 % F1 0.7611 [0.7126,0.8023] MCC 0.5853; 384 px / 12.5 % F1 0.6574 [0.6038,0.7056] MCC 0.3066; 384 px / 50 % F1 0.7293 [0.6841,0.7686] MCC 0.4909. TWO STANDING PRIORS OVERTURNED. (1) 512 px wins at every overlap and every K, so the 384 px sweet spot does NOT reproduce under one footprint at T=0.7: tile-size effect -0.0803 at 12.5 % [-0.1236,-0.0394] and -0.0976 at 50 % [-0.1206,-0.0752], both excluding zero. (2) Passes do NOT substitute for overlap: 384 px / 12.5 % at K=10 loses to 512 px / 50 % at K=3 by 0.0304 union recall and 0.0926 best F1, at lower cost. NOTE THE SIGN ON OVERLAP: the paired contrasts are computed on run-averaged single-pass per-tile counts with NO consensus filter, so (12.5 % - 50 %) = +0.1207 at 512 px and +0.1381 at 384 px means 50 % overlap COSTS about 0.12-0.14 F1 at a single pass. Overlap reverses and becomes the most valuable factor in the grid only once the corroboration filter it creates is switched on -- which is why the best cell is a 50 % one. Tile size never reverses. The interaction is UNRESOLVED: difference-of-differences -0.0173 [-0.0580,+0.0248], p=0.4033, spanning zero. ALL OF THIS IS CONDITIONAL ON THE ABSENCE OF A PRECISION STAGE: no verifier has run over any grid cell, so whether the tile-size ranking and the overlap effect survive verification is untested (recall-levers programme Phase 1, $6.33). Bootstrap intervals here are at B=10,000 per the 2026-08-19 PI ruling (erratum E82), not the 1,000 Decision 10 pre-specified; the paired contrasts use the analysis script's own resampler, which was never on the D15 defective path, so re-running them at 10,000 moved every delta by 0.00000, every CI width by under 5 %, and no significance verdict. Two of 228 swept cells have an undefined tile MCC, reported as null and never as 0.0 (E81). Artefacts: results/grid-2026-08-18/{grid_analysis.json,sweep.csv,findings.md} and the four per-cell evaluations under results/grid-2026-08-18/conditions/; scripts grid_prepare_scoring.py, grid_analysis.py, grid_materialise_conditions.py.

Best per cell (best-F1@20m; BCa CI95 at B=10,000): 384/50 p>=0.15 k>=10 F1 0.9017 [0.8727,0.9244] MCC 0.8037; 512/50 p>=0.15 k>=9 F1 0.8870 [0.8583,0.9118] MCC 0.8087; 384/12.5 p>=0.15 k>=7 F1 0.8761 MCC 0.7852 (the registered condition keeps p>=0.20 k>=7: F1 0.8752 [0.8424,0.9017] MCC 0.7852); 512/12.5 p>=0.15 k>=5 F1 0.8368 [0.7995,0.8676] MCC 0.8011. BOTH QUESTIONS THE CONSENSUS-ONLY BOARD LEFT OPEN ARE SETTLED, THE SECOND AT 512 PX ONLY. (1) The tile-size ranking REVERSES under the full pipeline: (384-512) = +0.0393 [+0.0052,+0.0741] p=0.0266 at 12.5% overlap — excluding zero on the OPPOSITE side of the consensus-only -0.0803 — and +0.0147 [-0.0095,+0.0394] p=0.2454 at 50% (sign reversed, unresolved). (2) The overlap reversal SURVIVES the verifier at 512 px but FAILS at 384 px: 50% wins significantly at 512 px ((12.5-50) = -0.0502 [-0.0778,-0.0224] p=0.0003) but not at 384 px (-0.0256 [-0.0517,+0.0001] p=0.0541, the interval reaching +0.0001), at roughly HALF the consensus-only margin — the corroboration filter and the verifier are partially redundant, and the surviving advantage tracks the recall-ceiling edge, as the findings doc predicted. Interaction unresolved (-0.0246 [-0.0613,+0.0114], p=0.1831). CONSENSUS AND VERIFIER ARE COMPLEMENTS, NOT SUBSTITUTES: every cell's best operating point retains a vote threshold (k>=5..10) atop the probability threshold; the pure-verifier k=1 board tops out at 0.8187 (384/12.5) and trails the stacked optimum in every cell by 0.057-0.207. Verifier gain over the consensus-only board +0.126..+0.219 best-F1, largest where consensus-only was worst (the 384 px cells). Best-F1 operating points are selected on the same ground truth they are scored on, as on the consensus board (E41-class calibration caveat). 4.15.draft: SPLIT — the leak signature is real and the boards barely move. (1) SIGNATURE, on the full frames: on the Era-2 board an image-bearing cell's false-positive rate on the 20 exposed tiles is 0.561x its rate on the other 467, against 0.685x for a text control (mean log ratio -0.1433 vs -0.0552; difference -0.0881, p < 1e-4 by 10,000-draw label permutation, seed 42). It is not a between-run confound: restricted to pv-diag-384, which supplies 54 image and 61 text cells from one pipeline, the difference is -0.0773, p < 1e-4. The three Era-1 boards are null unstratified (p 0.25-0.45); stratifying by run lifts era1-leaderboard to -0.0705 (p 0.021) but heterogeneously (retest-phase3a -0.235, retest-phase2c +0.139). (2) PER-CELL: on the Era-2 board no cell's F1@20 moves more than 0.0074 and no cell's tile-MCC more than 0.0120; mean deltas -0.00213 (image) vs -0.00275 (text) for F1 and -0.00126 vs -0.00286 for MCC — the reduction costs the image cells LESS, not more, because the exposed tiles hold 12 of the frame's 435 references as well as the quiet ground. The Era-1 boards move an order of magnitude more (mean delta F1 -0.015 to -0.021) because their reduction removes 9.6% of the positives against 2.8%; that frame effect is shared by every cell, which is why the text controls and not zero are the reference. (3) THE BOARD REBUILT (against the Era-2 board as committed before the S164 restatement, whose full-frame figures stand on the left of each arrow; the restated board has 8075 significant F1 pairs, 14 tiers, a Tier 1 of 5 cells, 3001 significant tile-MCC pairs, 6 MCC tiers, an MCC Tier 1 of 34, and Hsu MCB admissible sets of 52 (F1) and 60 (tile-MCC), and the reduced-frame rebuild has not been re-run on it): tie-set EDGES do move. Any text quoting a tie-set SIZE is frame-specific and should say so. Incidental: 7 Era-2 cells' exposure differs from the board's own 'track' field — three proposer-verifier '-image' cells are text-proposer (track names the verifier) and the four pv-scale4-optimal cells are image-bearing (detect_h8_scale-4_v2, include_example_images true), two of them in tile-MCC Tier 1.
